set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/motion. Acceptance: use existing opaque unit types in RigidPose via Translation3Mm/EulerZYXRad or equivalent; add FrameCount/FrameAligned or RunMotion wrappers; represent FD/DVARS as frame-pair metrics with compatibility adapters; replace DVARS robust Boolean with DvarsPolicy; add typed QC thresholds and explicit missing fit-cost traces; replace loose capture/temporal booleans with policy ADTs. Coordinate with active motion issue bd-01KWWWD67HVZ95V85B2QPAB8GX before editing overlapping files. Verification: motionJVM/test and motionJS/test.
set.title: Type motion poses, frame alignment, pair metrics, and QC policies
